**Online+ 8-Week M.A. in Interdisciplinary Studies – Concentrations**

The Online+ 8-week M.A. in Interdisciplinary Studies at Texas Tech University allows you to design a customized degree by selecting three approved academic areas (concentrations). The specific concentrations available in the Online+ 8-week format are determined in consultation with your advisor and must be offered through Texas Tech Online+.

**Key Points:**
- The program is flexible and tailored to your interests, but concentrations must be available in the Online+ 8-week asynchronous format.
- Common concentration areas include (but are not limited to):
  - Social Sciences (e.g., Communication, Sociology, Political Science)
  - Humanities (e.g., English, History, Philosophy)
  - Business and Leadership
  - Education
  - Health Sciences (non-clinical)
  - Other approved Online+ disciplines

**Important Notes:**
- Not every concentration offered by Texas Tech is available in the Online+ 8-week format.
- Your final selection of concentrations must be approved by your academic advisor to ensure they are available online and fit within the 8-week course structure.

- To confirm which specific concentrations are currently available in the Online+ 8-week format, contact an advisor through [Request Information](https://www.depts.ttu.edu/online/programs/rfi-form.php) or reach out to TTU Online+ at 1-844-691-0494 or online@ttu.edu.

**Summary:**  
You can choose from a variety of concentrations, but only those offered in the Online+ 8-week format are eligible. An advisor will help you select and confirm your options.

**Texas Tech Online+ Graduate Program Overview**

**What is Texas Tech Online+ (TTU Online+)?**
- TTU Online+ is a fully online, student-centered learning model at Texas Tech University.
- Features structured support, 8-week accelerated courses, and dedicated staff to help students succeed from start to finish.

**Key Features**
- **8-Week Terms:** Graduate courses are delivered in accelerated 8-week terms (instead of traditional 16-week semesters), allowing you to focus on fewer courses at a time and progress efficiently toward your degree.
- **Fully Online & Asynchronous:** All courses are 100% online with no required live class meetings, providing maximum flexibility for working professionals and those with busy schedules.
- **Multiple Start Dates:** Terms are offered year-round, giving you several opportunities to begin or continue coursework throughout the academic year.
- **Academic Rigor:** The degree title, learning outcomes, credit hours, academic standards, and accreditation remain the same as on-campus programs. Only the delivery format and term length are different.
- **Support Services:** Online+ students receive access to academic advising, Online Student Advocates, tutoring, writing center support, technical support, and student success resources.

**Enrollment & Course Load**
- **Full-time:** 6 credit hours per 8-week term
- **Half-time:** 3–5 credit hours per term
- **Typical Load:** Most students take 1–2 courses per term, depending on their goals and schedule.
- **Time Commitment:** Plan for approximately 90 minutes of study per day.

**Technology Requirements**
- Reliable internet access
- Supported web browser
- Computer capable of streaming video and uploading assignments
- Access to the university’s learning management system

**Who Should Consider Online+?**
- Working professionals
- Students with family or other commitments
- Those seeking a flexible, accelerated path to a graduate degree

**Accreditation**
- Texas Tech University is accredited by the Southern Association of Colleges and Schools Commission on Colleges (SACSCOC).
- Online+ programs meet the same rigorous academic standards as on-campus programs.

**Next Steps**
- Explore programs: [TTU Online Graduate Programs](https://www.depts.ttu.edu/online/programs/)
- Apply online: [TTU Online+ Application](https://www.depts.ttu.edu/online/apply/)
- Contact for questions: 1-844-691-0494 or online@ttu.edu

If you have specific questions about a graduate program, admissions, or student support, let me know!

If you are interested in pursuing a doctoral graduate degree via distance, you can still do so at Texas Tech University with the Doctor of Education in agricultural education degree program.

It is designed to develop independent and critical thinking. **Online Graduate Degree Plans Offered by Texas Tech University Online**

Texas Tech University Online offers a wide range of fully online graduate degrees designed for flexibility and career advancement. Below are the main categories and specific programs available:

---

**Business & Leadership**
- Master of Business Administration (MBA)
- Master of Science in Human Resource Management
- Master of Science in Leadership Studies

**Education & Counseling**
- Master of Education in Educational Leadership – Policy (Non-Certification)
- Master of Education in Higher Education Administration
- Master of Education in School Counseling
- Advanced School Counseling Certificate (for those with a counseling master’s degree)
- AI in Teaching, Learning, and School Transformation (Graduate Certificate)
- Raider Teach Educator Preparation Program (alternative teacher certification)

**Social Sciences & Humanities**
- Master of Arts in English
- Master of Arts in Technical Communication
- Master of Arts in Mass Communication
- Master of Arts in History
- Master of Arts in Communication Studies
- Master of Science in Human Development and Family Sciences
- Master of Science in Human Sciences

**Science, Technology & Health**
- Master of Science in Animal Health and Industry
- Master of Science in Plant & Soil Science
- Master of Science in Horticulture Science
- Master of Science in Nutritional Sciences
- Master of Science in Software & Security Engineering
- Master of Science in Environmental Design
- Master of Science in Agricultural Communications
- Master of Science in Agricultural Education

**Legal & Public Service**
- Master of Arts in Legal Studies in Energy
- Master of Public Administration (MPA)

**Specialized & Interdisciplinary**
- Master of Science in Personal Financial Planning
- Master of Science in Environmental Sustainability and Natural Resource Management (Professional Science Master’s)
- Master of Arts in Interdisciplinary Studies / Master of Science in Interdisciplinary Sciences

---

**Key Features**
- 100% online and asynchronous (no required live sessions)
- Flexible for working professionals and adult learners
- Multiple start dates per year (for Online+ programs)
- Personalized support from application to graduation

---

**How to Explore All Online Graduate Programs**

- View the full list of programs and details: [TTU Online Graduate Programs](https://www.depts.ttu.edu/online/programs/)
- For questions or personalized guidance, contact TTU Online+ at 1-844-691-0494 or online@ttu.edu.

---

- Contact an Enrollment Service Specialist for help choosing the right graduate program for your goals.
